description: This file defines a FastAPI dependency for extracting and validating the current user from a JWT token, used for authentication purposes. It includes an asynchronous function get_current_user that processes the token, decodes it, verifies user existence, and handles authentication errors.

classes.name: User
classes.description: An ORM model representing a user in the database

methods.description: FastAPI dependency that extracts and validates the current user from a JWT token, raising HTTP 401 if invalid or not found.

ctags.signature: ( token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), )
